The UCLA Neuroscience Interdepartmental Program (NSIDP) strives to give its students the necessary tools and perspectives to become leaders in Neuroscience related disciplines. NSIDP succeeds through a didactic curriculum, individualized advising and strong focus on career development. The major focus of the program is on neuroscience related biomedical research at the basic and translational level. Over 150 faculty from diverse Departments and Schools at UCLA are part of the program. Scientific interactions and collaborations within UCLA and across the world form the backbone of the Neuroscience research at UCLA. We encourage you to explore this website to familiarize yourself with the NSIDP. Please do not hesitate to ask any questions by writing an email to neurophd@mednet.ucla.edu
